# The script surface of a Code node (FEAT-vjjs8t): every property a script can
# reach that a bare goja VM does not have, with what it holds. Generated by
# go test ./internal/jsrun -run TestTheScriptSurfaceIsTheReviewedOne -update-surface
# Review every changed line before committing it: each is something a script can
# now read, call or replace. "library" is a vendored library, listed by its root.
